hosts.notes: The estate domain controller LabDC01, forest ad.labdomain.dev (LAB). Re-pointed 2026-08-03 from the retired shared host mvmcitest01 / ad.hraedon.com, which the SSH transport retirement took out of service; the host_id is historical and does not imply the lane executes on the DC. Lanes needing GPMC run on member-ws2025-disposable and reach this host for AD and SYSVOL, which is what wp2-native-import exercised end to end. Certifications produced against mvmcitest01 keep the environment recorded in their own manifests and are not retracted.

The estate client guest LabCL01. Qualified 2026-08-03 by a real 26200 client run that applied policy and observed CSE evidence (passed, no lane or control problems). Re-frozen 2026-07-29 from 24H2/26100 to 25H2/26200. Two measured limits shape every lane that uses it: the GroupPolicy module is absent (RSAT is a Feature-on-Demand the isolated estate cannot fetch), and the estate has never had an interactive logon, so user-scope resolution is WP-9 rather than WP-6.

The estate member server LabMS01, domain-joined, checkpoint-backed. Qualified 2026-08-03 by a 20/20 WP-3 run with zero environment violations. This is where WP-0, WP-1B, WP-2 and WP-3 actually execute: the same estate qualification also produced live-synthetic-registry-basic-20260803213433-5325 (WP-0), wp1b-writer-20260803213602-6066 (WP-1B) and wp2-native-import-20260803230132-8090 (WP-2) on this host. Qualifying the host does not itself expand any lane: that run exercised the same validate/import/export tranche as the shared host did, so secedit /configure and the wider template areas remain unexecuted work, not new evidence.

tools.notes: Qualified on version family per environment-spec.md (changed 2026-07-29 from exact servicing revision, so Patch Tuesday no longer silently downgrades runs); the exact revision is recorded per manifest.

Pinned in environment-spec.md. Server-side only: it is present on the estate member server and absent on the client guest, so a lane may use it to author or inspect a topology but may not rely on it as a client-side oracle.

Recorded, not qualified (changed 2026-07-29): no current lane executes LGPO, so its hash is provenance only. Ruled 2026-08-03 that placing LGPO.exe on the estate is acceptable — disposable, checkpoint-backed guests, and the isolation invariant governs egress rather than what is deliberately placed inside — so WP-5 keeps its LGPO leg and this row is not pending because the tool was ruled out. It is pending because qualification is earned by execution: WP-5 must push the binary post-restore, verify it on the guest against a pinned SHA-256, and only then restore the check in frozen_environment_violations(). Do not flip this row on the strength of the ruling alone.

tools.frozen_version: rides the server OS build family (26100)
tools.notes: Qualified 2026-08-03: the estate WP-3 run wp3-security-template-20260803230220-2450 exercised it 20/20 with environment_matches_frozen_spec true, on a host whose build family is pinned. It rides the OS build rather than carrying its own version pin, which is why environment-spec.md records it that way. Note what this does not cover: /configure has still never been invoked by any lane.

tools.frozen_version: rides the client OS build family (26200)
tools.notes: Qualified by the client-win11 qualification 2026-08-03. Two measured facts the rsop-endpoint lane is built on, both of which contradict the oracle this registry previously claimed: Get-GPResultantSetOfPolicy is NOT available (no GroupPolicy module on the client), so the lane is gpresult.exe-only; and `gpresult /x` without /scope:computer exits 0, writes no file, and reports that the invoking account has no RSoP data. Assert on the artifact, never on the exit code.

User-context token collection, and the honest reason the user-scope lane is still gated. WP-6 forbids using an interactive whoami /groups as the computer token; the computer side uses LDAP tokenGroups via [adsisearcher], which is measured available and needs no interactive session. whoami's collection therefore rides an interactive logon the estate has never had, which is WP-9 work, not a consequence of the client qualification.
finalize_oracle_run.py and lane finalizers; commit-bound through the WP-0 integrity pack rather than version-pinned.

lanes.oracle: Native GPMC-authored backup captures (committed, sanitized) read through Studio's public import path; no Studio participation on the expected side.
lanes.notes: Fifteen genuine captures committed under tests/fixtures/native-gpp-gpmc. Analysis of existing captures executes offline today; new captures require the lab.

lanes.oracle: Import-GPO of a Studio-authored native backup, then GPMC report parse plus Backup-GPO round trip; agreement is between two independent readers of the same policy.
lanes.notes: Certified for drives, local users and groups, daily Exec TaskV2 scheduled tasks, and Services plus the registry-both control. The clean seven-candidate run is wp1b-writer-20260730151953-6878; Services is GPMC writer-conformance evidence, not endpoint application.

lanes.oracle: secedit /validate, /import /overwrite into a fresh temporary database, /export; semantic comparison against the exported template. /configure is never invoked on a shared host.
lanes.notes: Account/audit/user-rights tranche certified, and re-certified on the estate 2026-08-03 (wp3-security-template-20260803230220-2450, 20/20). Expansion to the services, regkeys, filestore and group_mgmt areas is no longer platform-gated — the disposable host exists and is qualified — but it is also not done: the estate run repeated the certified tranche rather than widening it. This is the lane most likely to find something, because security_template.py is the one domain layer already proven wrong on the wire.

lanes.oracle: LGPO import, policy refresh, direct registry API reads, and GroupPolicy operational events on a snapshot-backed endpoint, plus domain-GPO processing through the verified WP-2 path.
lanes.notes: Hosts qualified 2026-08-03; now blocked only on lgpo, which the 2026-08-03 ruling keeps in the lane rather than narrowing it away. The binary must be pushed post-restore over psdirect and hash-verified on the guest, so no golden checkpoint carries it. The domain-GPO leg is the one that tests Studio (its output reaching a client through SYSVOL); the LGPO leg mostly tests Microsoft's tool, and WP-5 acceptance requires both.

lanes.oracle: gpresult.exe /x <file> /f /scope:computer on the client, parsed from the http://www.microsoft.com/GroupPolicy/Rsop namespace, plus direct winning-registry reads, GroupPolicy operational events, LDAP tokenGroups via [adsisearcher] for the computer token, and Get-Acl / Get-GPPermission -All for effective rights.
lanes.notes: Computer scope only, per the 2026-08-03 ruling; user scope and loopback are the rsop-user-loopback lane. Platforms qualified 2026-08-03, so this lane is no longer platform-blocked — it is unbuilt, which is WP-6B. Two corrections from measuring the client: Get-GPResultantSetOfPolicy is gone from the oracle because the module is absent, and whoami is gone from required_tools because the computer token comes from LDAP tokenGroups. Deterministic disposable topology per WP-6; no use of pre-existing lab GPOs; at least one control row must be decided by a mechanism Studio does not model.

lanes.oracle: gpresult.exe /x <file> /f /scope:user captured under a real interactive session on the client, direct winning HKCU reads, and user token groups collected separately from the computer token.
lanes.notes: Created 2026-08-03 when WP-6 was ruled computer-scope-only, so the deferral carries a lane and a gate instead of disappearing. Blocked on whoami, which stands in for the real gap: the estate has never had an interactive logon and PowerShell Direct does not provide one. WP-9 establishes one by scripted autologon plus a dedicated checkpoint, because a hand-made session is unrepeatable and would fail WP-8. Get-GPResultantSetOfPolicy -User from the member server is a possible second oracle but is untested across the private switch, so it is a bonus and not the plan.
